cards.selection: Willy Hutchinson moneyline vs Joshua Buatsi
cards.decision: Do not bet at −110; require +105 or better after final fight-status and weigh-in confirmation.
cards.statusReason: The rematch and Hutchinson's post-loss form justify monitoring, but Buatsi scored two knockdowns in the first fight and the current −110 price offers no upset compensation. Upgrade only if a named book reaches +105 or better.
cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook frames a rematch of Buatsi's 2024 split-decision win after both men handled their subsequent business. The opposing record matters more than the split label alone: WBC reporting records two Buatsi knockdowns and two wide Buatsi cards. DraftKings' −110 implies 52.4%; removing the two-way hold from −115/−110 produces roughly 49.5%, or +102, for Hutchinson, leaving the current quote short of value.
cards.movement: Tracked market references call the fight steady since Nov. 2. Direct DraftKings lists Hutchinson −110 / Buatsi −115; an aggregator reports FanDuel −112 each, so book disagreement is small.
cards.priceNote: Directly confirmed DraftKings quote; FanDuel is an aggregator-only reference. No internal snapshot check was required because the published whole-card start is outside 30 hours.

cards.selection: Cheavon Clarke moneyline vs Chris Billam-Smith
cards.observedPrice: DRAFTKINGS DIRECT +340 · HARD ROCK +375 AGGREGATOR REFERENCE
cards.decision: Do not bet +340; require a directly confirmed +375 or better after exact-market and fight-status checks.
cards.statusReason: Clarke's amateur history and comeback win create a live underdog case, but +340 is below the +363 no-vig benchmark from DraftKings' own two-way line. The better +375 number is aggregator-only and cannot activate PLAY.
cards.rationale: The weekly source identifies a 10-round cruiserweight main event, while current official Zuffa material confirms the format and exact Chev/Cheavon Clarke identity. Clarke went 2-0 against Billam-Smith as an amateur and recently recovered from two knockdowns to stop Jack Massey; Billam-Smith counters with proven professional championship experience and a stoppage of Ryan Rozicki. DraftKings' +340/−475 pair normalizes Clarke near 21.6%, equivalent to about +363, so +340 is too short.
cards.movement: An aggregator says the best-available dog line has held near +375 since Oct. 31 while the favorite moved from about −370 to −400 at its best. Direct DraftKings remains +340 / −475.
cards.priceNote: DraftKings quote is directly confirmed. Hard Rock +375 is an aggregator-only market reference and must be verified at the named book before any promotion.

cards.selection: Alycia Baumgardner moneyline vs Elif Nur Turhan
cards.decision: Do not bet −475; require −350 or better plus final weight and fight-status confirmation.
cards.statusReason: Baumgardner's timing plan fits Turhan's pressure, but the evidence is self-assessment and the challenger is stepping up against an unbeaten defending champion. DraftKings' −475 is materially shorter than its own roughly −363 no-vig benchmark, so only substantial drift can reopen value.
cards.rationale: Baumgardner says Turhan's mauling approach leaves openings for composed counters and that her own timing and power are the answers. The neutral counterweight is significant: MVP identifies Turhan as 14-0 with eight knockouts and two 2026 defenses, while Baumgardner moves above 130 pounds for the first time in more than five years. Direct DraftKings +340/−475 normalizes Baumgardner near 78.4%, about −363, and the broad reference range shows an immature, disagreeing market.
cards.movement: No reliable opening-to-current move was confirmed. Current references range from roughly −420 to −700 on Baumgardner, a large disagreement that makes line shopping and final confirmation essential.
